(123)yun ring dus nas chos kyis bskyang ba'i bu/bslab gsum dri med rin chen yangs ba'i gzhir/bcu phrag rig pa'i lhun po'i rtsar son pa'i/bshes gnyen

tei:div.tei:p: (123)yun ring dus nas chos kyis bskyang ba'i bu/ bslab gsum dri med rin chen yangs ba'i gzhir/ bcu phrag rig pa'i lhun po'i rtsar son pa'i/ bshes gnyen mig stong ldan pa gang drung du/ dben pa'i ri la brten pa'i bhu su ku/ sngon byon drang srong dgyes pa'i brtul zhugs la/ yid 'di rnam par dga' ba'i bsam gtan pa/ rjes las thob pa'i zhu mched spros lags so/ ston pa thugs rje can de'i gsung gi mjod/ yon tan rtsa ba tshul khrims rin po che/ dri med srung la rang sems mi khrel ba'i/ bag yod rgan po'i rtog dpyod rgyud la rgyob/ khyim chen spang nas khyim chung tsho 'jin la/ yang dag thar ba'i lam du mthun pa nyung*/ 'on kyang bslu med dkon mchog rnam gsum la/ snying nas gus pa'i blo rtse ma 'chug cig 'khor ba'i bde sdug rang gi las 'bras la/ dbang yod sus kyang gzhan du mi bsgyur na/ rgyu 'bras zab mo bslu ba med pa la/ yid ches nges pas zhib tsha ci thon gyis/ mthon (124)po'i lta bas phal cher ngan 'gror 'phen/ rgyu 'bras gnas la spang blang ma zhan dang*/ gong ma'i 'bras bu je bas je bzang du/ 'phel ba skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu lags/ deng sang skyes bos theg pa'i rtser mor snyogs/ bla slob gnyis gas rgyu 'bras kha mi chags/ cang med po la lta ba mthon ser btags/ snyigs ma'i skye bo phal cher rlung la bskur/ khyed rnams mthon po'i kha lta ma khyer bar/ dang po rang gi sems 'di nang du khug rgyud la zhib mo'i rtog dpyod zhib du rgyob/ lam lnga'i yon tan gang dang ldan nam ltos/ rang kha'i skye bo tha mal rang rgyud pa/ lam lnga'i yon tan gang dang mi ldan pa/ 'phags pa'i skye bor sgro btags pho tshod 'dis/ nying 'khrul 'akor la sa bon slar yang spel/ mi gcig lto gos ci ltar byed kyang byed/ rang gis rang btsong ngo cha med pa yis/ dkor za grong khyams mdo med stong 'khyams la/

mi tshe nyi ma ma phul sku tshe ring*/ rnyed bstod snyan grags bdud kyi phye gtor 'dis/ deng sang dus kyi chos sa phal (125)cher bslus/ chos brgyad spang ba'i dal 'byor don yod la/ sgo gsum dag pa'i lam la ci tshud gyis/ snga 'gyur brgyud pa'i chu bo las 'ong ba'i/ bskyed dang rdzogs dang rjogs pa chen po'i lam/ dad brtson shes rab can gyi 'byor ba'i gnas/ gnam gyi skar ma khyi la ba la bstan pa ltar/ 'on kyang bsam pa bzang po'i nyams len la/ rnam mkhyen lam gyi srog rtsa thams cad 'dus/ 'di nyid yod na sangs rgyas chos yod la/ med na sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i re ba med/ de phyir byang chub sems kyis sems byang nas/ sems 'di nang nas dge bar 'gyur shig dang*/ gzhan pa'i nyams len med kyang chog par smra/ 'di med bskyed rjogs zhugs pa don ma mchis/ lta ba mthon po kha la khyer ba dang*/ spyod pa dman pa khyi las zhan pa gnyis/ yang dag rig pa'i lam du 'gal bas na/ dpyod ldan skye bo khrel la ma bskur cig bka' drin gsam ldan bla ma sangs rgyas dngos/ bstas nas mos pas gsol ba 'debs (126)pas na/ don brgyud dgongs pa 'pho ba'i tha tshig la/ 'od gsal snying thig brgyud pa nam yang brten/ grub brgya'i spyi myes mnyam med sgam po pas/ ma mthong mngon shes rmang po'i sre gos dang*/ chos brgyad dbang gis nad pa'i ngas srung gsum/ chos pa pad kyis khyer ba'i rgyur gsungs spangs/ thos pa mang po thos pa'i lam du bzhag nyams len zab zab gzhan nas tshol ba ni/ thos don bsam shing bsgom pas skyong ba yi/ nges pa'i tshig la rab tu rmongs par zad/ sngar nas mdo rgyud man ngag zab mo'i gnad/ brgya phrag mang po thob pa'i kha byang can/ da ni bsam pas skyong ba'i dus yin na/ mdo rgyud lung dang rang rgyud zhu dag gyis/ mdor na dus rnams kun tu rang gi sems/ mdo rgyud gzhung dang bla ma'i man ngag la/ mthun nam snyam nas rang sems dge la bskul/

mi dge'i rtog pa dug bzhin 'jom bag byos/ dal 'byor snyed dka' 'chi ba mi rtag dang*/ rgyu 'bras bsam dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams/ blo sbyong zer ba sems 'di'i 'gro ldog (127)yin/ 'di ni ngan par ma lta rgyud la sbyor/ blo sbyong rtsal la blo sna mi khug shing*/ 'phags pa'i ye shes nyams len 'dod pa ni/ bram ze phru gu btsun mor dus btab bzhin/ ha cang rlom pa'i spyi brtol che bar zad/ kho bo ha cang mkhas pa ma yin mod/ 'on kyang snying thig brgyud pa'i gral skyes pas/ gong ma'i gdams pa chos zab snyan brgyud rnams/ chad lhag med par bri sba ma byas par/ bshad pa thams cad don med ma byed cig da dung spros pa'i rtsa tshig yod med kyang*/ dben pa'i ri la g.yeng ba'i bya ba 'di/ lha dang drang srong dgyes par mi 'gro bar/ shes nas re zhig gtam gyi dal gso byas/ dben khro ljon pa lung nas zhu 'dogs bcas

chos grags dang*/ dbang phyug rab bstan gnyis la/ mtshan/ mkhan ming pas phul bas dus kun tu nyams su len pa'i rtsa tshig yang dag pa lags so/ (128)rgyal kun gsung gi dbang phyug 'od dpag med/ rmad byung mjad pa gang gis zla med pa/ gangs can bstan pa'i thog mar srol 'byed pa/ bka' drin mtshungs med mtsho skyes rdo rje 'dud/ nyid nas rjes brtses khyab pa'i yi ge dang*/ rin chen gnyis pa'i dong tshe rten bcas dang*/ blang dor bslab ston brtse bas 'dom pa yi/ mig gi lam du bstar ba yid spro bart+sa/ ngas kyang 'di nas bshes gnyen dam pa brten/ thos bsam brtson pa tshul bzhin yin snyam kyang*/ rang blo nus pas snga 'gyur theg pa'i gzhung*/ shin tu zab cing brling bas tshul bzhin du/ rtogs pa dka' na'ang cung zad nges pa zhu/ phal po che las gzhon nu nor bzang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen byams pa brten pa'i tshul/ rang gi yid la yang yang ci nges kyis/ nyams su blangs pas yid tshim bgyid na snyam/ snga 'gyur mtsho skyes rdo rje'i rang lugs la/ rmad byung za hor mkhan po'i spyod pa dang*/ mtshungs med dpal ldan klu yi lta ba gnyis/ zung (129)'brel brgyud pa'i bka' srol phyag rgyas btab/ 'di la go ba rnal ma chags tsam lags/ thos pa chung bas 'dul ba'i gnang bkag gi mtshams rnams zhib mor nges pa ma 'tshal kyang*/ las 'bras bslu med nges pa'i yid ches kyis/ gzhan gnod gzhi bcas spang ba'i sems pa la/ so sor thar ba'i 'gags kun tshang na snyam/ bstan rtsa 'dul ba yinapa'i kha rgyug tsam/ kha la btags bzhin mi gsod rta bsgril zhing*/ mi tshe tshong dang ngag 'khyal gtam la g.yengs/ de 'dra'i lan mo bdag gi yid la med/ stong pa chos nyid spros dang bral ba dang*/ snang ba rten 'byung bslu ba med pa gnyis/ 'gal med gcig gi grogs su gcig 'gro ba/ snga 'gyur grub mtha'i snying po legs par mthong*/ 'dus byas dge dang 'dus ma byas dge ba/

phan tshun 'gal med stong dang rten 'byung du/ dbyer med mnyam pas res 'jog med pa 'tshal/ 'dus byas dge ba su yi (130)'gogs pa med/ klu yi slob ma dpal ldan zla bas kyang*/ snying rje'i sems dang gnyis su med blo dang*/ byang chub sems ni rgyal sras rnams kyi rgyu/ gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan gnas la su yis 'gongs/ dgag bya'i snang tshul ci bzhin nges pa na/ mtha' bral lta ba ji bzhin gzigs pa yi/ rgyal ba'i dbang po klong chen rab 'byams kyis/ grub mtha' rin po che nas bden grub bzhed/ ngal gso las kyang de bzhin 'di skad du/ snang bas mi 'tshing de la zhen pas 'ching*/ snang ba'i bden zhon gcod pa dbu ma'i lam/ bden pa gcig dang du ma bral ba yi/ nges pa rnyed pa dbu ma'i lta bur gsungs/ thal rang gnyis po dgag bya'i ngos 'jin dang*/ tha snyad 'jog 'tshams phra rags yod pa tsam/ grub mtha' kun la rlung ltar grags na yang*/ de 'dra'i rjes zlos tsam gyis ci zhig rung*/ tha snyad 'jog 'tshams tha snyad tshad ma 'di/ mtho dman theg pa'i rang lugs mang mod kyang*/ gcig po 'di las (131)(132)gzhan dag 'khrul pa brgyu/ sgrub na log par ltung bar mi 'gyur ram/ thabs lam tsam la bsngags pa'i e waṃ lam/ stong 'ur che yang ji bzhin spyod pa nyung*/ dbyings dang ye shes zung du 'jug pa'i lam/ ji bzhin nges kyang gsang ba sgrogs pas dgos/ mdo sngags bstan pa 'gal med rtogs pa'i gzhung*/ yid bzhin rin chen mjod kyis gzhung chen po/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag 'khrol byed nas/ gang zag gcig gi lam rim tshang bar ston/ 'gal 'du'i rigs pa ltar snang bcos mar go 'di 'dra'i mched zhus nyams mtshar tsam du phul/ rang gzhan grub mtha'i chags sdang bdag la med/ tshig gi rtsod pa byis pa'i rnam thar lags/ brag cha'i sgra snyan bzhin tu gus pas phul/// /
